objective: Games started by the daily demo are marked as demo games on the server (FR-28, #64): a POST /api/games carrying the right demo token is stored with source "demo", every other game with source "player"; the marker survives restarts; and every tutor reply log line carries the game's source so the later stats endpoint (#60) can report demo usage apart from real usage. Success: the cases in the rubric pass, existing databases migrate cleanly, and a player cannot set the marker by accident.
contract:
FR-28 (A7): Games started by the demo are marked as demo games on the server. The marker needs a secret (IR-10), so a player cannot set it by accident. Usage reporting shows demo games and their Claude spend apart from real usage.
IR-10 (A7): `DEMO_TOKEN` is a runtime environment variable on the server; a feature whose secret is unset is off.
Scope note: usage is not stored in the database today (it is only logged, e.g. games.ts finishAsk: `const meta = { gameId: g.id, kind, ok: outcome.ok, ms: outcome.ms, usage: outcome.usage }`). The separate reporting is #60's job. This round only (1) stores the marker and (2) adds `source` to the tutor log meta, so #60 can split on it.
Decisions (coordinator, also on issue #64):
- Header `x-demo-token` on `POST /api/games` (apps/server/src/app.ts:107-114, which today calls `games.create(color)`).
- DEMO_TOKEN unset or blank: the header is ignored entirely; the game is "player".
- DEMO_TOKEN set, header absent: "player".
- DEMO_TOKEN set, header present and equal (compare with node:crypto timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers; unequal lengths = mismatch): "demo".
- DEMO_TOKEN set, header present but wrong: 403 with the app's usual error body, no game created. (The demo should fail loudly, not quietly count as a player game.)
- The token never appears in logs, responses or the database.
- Store: SCHEMA_VERSION 2 -> 3; add `source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player'` to games (ALTER TABLE, following the v2 pattern in migrate(): check PRAGMA table_info first so it is idempotent). Old rows read back as "player". Load it on hydrate so a restored game keeps its source (NFR-14).
- `GameManager.create(playerColor, opts?: { source?: "player" | "demo" })`; default "player".
- Do not add `source` to the GameView API contract or the web app this round. It is a server-side fact.
- Read DEMO_TOKEN in main.ts (process.env, as main.ts:63 already does for other vars) and pass it into the app deps; app.ts tests inject it directly.
Tests go in apps/server/test/ (games-api.test.ts, game-survival.test.ts, outcome-pgn-store.test.ts are the existing homes for routes, restarts and the store). Do not edit deploy.test.ts (the parallel spoke uses it).
Gate at base a2f2b19 (run by the coordinator): `pnpm test` -> Tests 1200 passed (1200); `pnpm typecheck` clean.
negative: Do not edit files outside scope, docs, config, .github, root files or the lockfile.

Never log or persist the token value.
rubric: Tests first (red then green) for each case: token unset + header -> player; set + no header -> player; set + right header -> demo (201); set + wrong header -> 403, no game stored; wrong-length header -> 403; source survives a restart; a v2 database migrates to v3 with old rows as player; tutor log meta includes source.
